perspective:
From RECOMMENDER’s perspective, they have access to:

- SEEKER is looking for a film of any genre with a woman in the lead and wants a good heroine.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *The Blind Side* (2009) with Sandra Bullock and asked if SEEKER had seen it.
- SEEKER said they had not seen *The Blind Side* and asked if it was about her adopting a black kid. RECOMMENDER confirmed it was and said it was really good.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *The Help* (2011) with Emma Stone and Viola Davis.
- SEEKER said they would rent it tonight, had seen “that,” and that it made them cry and laugh throughout. RECOMMENDER responded that they loved it.
- RECOMMENDER said they also really like *Precious*, describing it as about a girl whose mother is mean to her.
- SEEKER said they tried to watch *Precious* but couldn’t because it was too sad; they said they were overweight in their early 20s and it brought back memories.
- RECOMMENDER responded that it was awful and that the girl had to deal with so much.
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* (2011), describing it as another good Sandra Bullock film.
- SEEKER asked if it was based on the novel of the same name. RECOMMENDER said they were not sure and described it as about an autistic boy who loses his father on 9/11.
- SEEKER confirmed that was the one, said they had read and loved the book but had never seen the movie.
- RECOMMENDER said it was very sad but very good.
- SEEKER said they cried through the entire book.

RECOMMENDER also has access to their own expressed opinions: that *The Blind Side* is really good, that they loved *The Help*, that they really like *Precious*, and that *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* is very sad but very good.
